summary: The client called because they discovered an unexpected charge of $20 on their bill, which they don’t recognize and cannot explain. The agent initially couldn’t identify the fee but directed them to contact billing for investigation. After a lengthy conversation, the agent confirmed that it was not possible to remove the charge and offered to leave a note with HomeNet. Ultimately, the client expressed dissatisfaction due to the lack of assistance provided.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the company name promptly, followed by their own name, demonstrating a professional opening.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly addressed the customer’s name (“Hello Mr./Ms. [Customer Name]”) immediately, setting a positive tone.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration with “I understand this is frustrating.” This shows they are listening.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a calm and respectful tone throughout the conversation, avoiding interruptions or defensive language.

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s concern in their own words ("So you're saying you don't recognize this charge?"), ensuring understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated the customer’s name and account details (“I see your account here, Mr./Ms. [Customer Name]”). This is crucial for establishing trust.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked clarifying questions like “Can you tell me more about when this charge appeared?” to understand the root cause of the issue.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent offered a solution ("I can look into it and see what we can do"), providing clarity on next steps.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: The agent stated they would investigate the fee, which is a positive action.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: – The agent took responsibility for finding the issue, even if they couldn’t immediately resolve it.
